facts.fact: The World Bank says all Takaful and Karama beneficiaries are automatically linked with the food subsidy programme and universal health insurance.
facts.system: Takaful and Karama programme (TKP) social registry

facts.fact: The World Bank says all TKP beneficiaries receive Meeza debit cards for digital payments or ATM cash-out, and 100 percent are paid by electronic means as of December 2023.

The World Bank says cash-plus interventions (FORSA, family planning with UNFPA, Waii with UNDP, the 1,000 days programme with WFP) are built on and target beneficiaries from the TKP social registry, which holds about 11.3 million registered households (40.5 million individuals); undated, so the published date is used.
